subject: A 350-study review linked protein restriction to slower aging
script: From Agewell Brief: A 350-study review linked protein restriction to slower aging. A sweeping review of over 350 studies hints that eating less protein could boost health and lifespan, but experts urge caution. Review of 350+ papers links protein restriction to slower aging. May improve metabolism and reduce cellular damage. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
